data.long_meaning: The name Aureliah is derived from the Latin word 'aureus', which means 'golden'. It was a common name for Roman girls, symbolizing prosperity and wealth. in_greek.name: Αὐρηλία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αὐρηλία προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη Aurelia, η οποία με τη σειρά της προέρχεται από το όνομα Aurelius. Ο Αυρηλίας Προυντίος Κλήμενας ήταν επισκοπος της Ρώμης τον 5ο αιώνα. Στη χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Αὐρηλία σχετίζεται με τον τίτλο της κυρίας ή πριγκίπισσας. Η ονομασία αυτή συνδέεται επίσης με την ιδέα της σοβαρότητας, της σοφίας και της αρετής.

in_latin.name: Aureliah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Aureliah derivatum est a vocabulo Latinico Aurelia, quod autem a nomine masculino Aurelius ortum est. Aurelius Prudentius Clemens, episcopus Romanus saeculi quinti, in litteris sanctis notus est. In traditione Christiana, nomen Aureliah significat regem aut principem feminam. Haec nomen etiam ad gravitatem, prudentiam, et virtutem referuntur.

in_english.name: Aureliah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aureliah originates from the Latin name Aurelia, which in turn is derived from the male name Aurelius. Aurelius Prudentius Clemens, a 5th-century bishop of Rome, is notable in Christian literature. In Christian tradition, the name Aureliah signifies a queen or princess. This name is also associated with gravity, prudence, and virtue.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aureliah carries a rich cultural heritage, as it was once a popular name among the Romans. It symbolizes wealth, prosperity, and nobility, evoking images of ancient Rome's greatness and grandeur.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Aureliah takes on a deeper meaning. It is a reminder of Saint Aurelia, a brave and faith-filled woman who was martyred for her beliefs. Her name, which means 'golden', represents the golden virtues of holiness, purity, and faith. Aureliah's story inspires us to follow in her footsteps, to remain true to our faith in the face of adversity, and to strive for the golden virtues of the Christian faith.
